devices.description: List of serial device paths (e.g., USB GPS dongles) or network endpoints (e.g., 'localhost:2947') to monitor.

gpsd_options.description: Additional daemon flags. '-n' enables immediate polling of devices on startup; '-b' enables Bluetooth support.

pps_enable.description: Enable pulse-per-second (PPS) input for high-precision time discipline (e.g., with NTP/chrony). Requires compatible hardware.
